lines.text: Massive rocket engines ignite, blasting intense white fire upward among towering industrial scaffolds against a pale, hazy sky.
A glowing wire-frame human brain rests on a dish, surrounded by pink energy rings.
The title card fades to black, revealing an elevated open-air room cluttered with heavy cables, pillars, and large bells hanging from the ceiling.
A man aims a large sniper rifle from a ruined balcony, peering through the scope at an industrial airship hovering in the hazy sky.
Nearby, another man lies asleep with a newspaper covering his face while the sniper watches the airship glide over rooftops through his scope.
The older man sits up, removes the newspaper, and rubs his stiff neck as the sniper continues watching through his scope.
The older man stands, gripping a hanging rope, while the sniper takes a sip from a yellow juice carton.
The older man hauls on the thick rope, lifting a younger man dangling against a massive pipe organ before turning away to look across the dusty floor.
The older man walks across the industrial floor, then enters a brightly lit room where a young woman in military attire stands waiting.
The older man steps outside, looking toward a massive mechanical structure in the foggy square.
A glowing dome expands around the man as the woman watches.
A man in red points backward.
A young man in a patterned shirt and jacket solidifies from digital static on a canal bridge and walks away.
Thom works at a computer console while Celia stands outdoors near a city canal, then turns to look past him at the buildings across the water.
The view shifts through a telescope lens, panning across distant rooftops before focusing on the mechanical beast crouching among tiles.
Purple text appears near his metallic hand.
Thom kisses his.
A man with a cybernetic eye watches Thom kiss the metallic hand.
A woman watches the young man stand before the massive metal beast.
Thom looks up as a spaceship descends.
Thom tumbles backward onto a mattress, clutching his rifle, while a mechanical cylinder drops heavily into a circular console and vents smoke.
Thom glances up from a complex white mechanical device, turning his head sharply toward the right.
Four people in white hazmat suits kneel behind crates in a grand, sunlit hall as a bulky, grey-and-yellow mechanical beast steps into view.
Thom fires his rifle alongside three others in hazmat suits, then stands with the weapon before running through a towering, cavernous industrial interior.
Thom grabs a thick rope and swings up past a row of organ pipes.
Thom stands on a bridge, facing a giant mechanical beast.
The mechanical beast strikes the rusty pipe and sends a spray of sparks across the room, then a silver-haired man in a plaid shirt and jacket looks toward it.
The silver-haired man places his hands gently on the mechanical beast as its glowing eye illuminates.
The silver-haired man watches the man gesture.
The woman walks out of the room.
Blue wireframe graphics of a brain and a mechanical claw appear alongside scrolling animation credits.
Orange and blue wireframe blueprints scroll upward against a dark background, framing lists of crew credits.
Orange and blue wireframe blueprints continue scrolling upward, framing lists of crew credits.
More orange and blue blueprints scroll upward, displaying institutional credits and a web address.
A young man sits atop a massive pile of discarded robot parts and scrap metal.
The young man takes a sip from a small flask before the screen cuts to black.
